annotations.title: Extract Section B CLIN Pricing Tables, Quotes & Labor Rate Cards

description: Extract multi-tier CLIN/SLIN pricing schedules, GSA/T&M labor rate cards, vendor quotes, and Bill of Materials (BOM) tables from unstructured text into normalized JSON with automated line-item math auditing. This is a read-only, stateless extraction call (requires X-RapidAPI-Key; `document_text` accepts 20 to 100,000 characters, `expected_document_type` optionally hints the table schema, and `audit_math_and_anomalies` [default true] verifies `quantity * unit_price == extended_price` and flags arithmetic discrepancies). Use this tool when parsing pricing tables, CLIN schedules, invoices, or labor rate cards; use `parse_b2b_contract` instead for general contract dates/parties/deliverables, or `search_historical_awards` to look up historical government award prices.

audit_math_and_anomalies.description: When true (default), cross-checks each line item (`quantity * unit_price == total_price`) and subtotal summation, returning any arithmetic mismatches in `math_discrepancies`.

document_text.description: Raw text or copied table content from a Federal Section B CLIN schedule, T&M labor rate card, B2B vendor quote, BOM, or invoice (20 to 100,000 characters).

name: extract_pricing_schedule

base_period_total_usd.description: Sum of all Base Period / Year 1 / Initial Term line items in USD.

customer_or_agency_name.description: Buyer organization, government agency, or bill-to entity if present in the text.

document_title_or_reference.description: Extracted solicitation number, quote ID, invoice number, or contract title.

finops_and_price_to_win_summary.description: Executive FinOps & Price-to-Win (PTW) analysis summarizing blended labor rates, annual escalation percentages, discount depth, and negotiation leverage.

line_items.description: Normalized array of all extracted CLINs, SLINs, labor rate rows, and BOM SKUs.

math_and_pricing_anomalies.description: Arithmetic discrepancies (Quantity * Unit Price != Stated Total), missing NTE ceilings, or escalation anomalies.

options_total_usd.description: Sum of all Option Year / Renewal Tier line items in USD (0.0 if no option periods exist).

payment_terms_and_invoicing_rules.description: Extracted payment terms (e.g., 'Net 30', 'WAWF/IPP electronic invoicing', 'Milestone billing schedule', 'Annual upfront').

period_subtotals.description: Subtotal breakdown grouped by contract performance period or billing tier.

total_evaluated_contract_value_usd.description: Grand total contract ceiling or quote value across Base + All Option Periods in USD.

vendor_or_issuer_name.description: Vendor, prime contractor, or quote issuer name if present in the text.

title: Extract Section B CLIN Pricing Tables, Quotes & Labor Rate Cards
